> JGS Construction Services Limited is a family-run Derbyshire driveway, patio and groundworks contractor. Based at 3 Tumbling Hill, Heage, Belper, Derbyshire DE56 2BX. Telephone 07702 543174. Email info@jgslimited.co.uk. Over 35 years' hands-on experience. Derbyshire County Council Trusted Trader. Street Works (NRSWA) qualified. Fully insured.

## About

JGS Construction installs and renews block paving driveways, tarmac drives, patios, drop kerbs, fencing and landscaping, and full drainage work across Derbyshire. We cover Derby, Belper, Ripley, Heanor, Alfreton, Matlock, Chesterfield, Long Eaton, Ilkeston, Codnor, Kilburn and surrounding areas. Family-run by John (Owner & Founder) and Joe (Owner & Site Manager). All work is carried out by our own qualified team — no subcontractors. We are rated 4.8 / 5 by 17 verified Google reviewers.

## Services

- [Block Paving](https://www.jgslimited.co.uk/block-paving/): Hard-wearing block paved driveways, paths, and patios.
- [Tarmac Driveways](https://www.jgslimited.co.uk/tarmac-drives/): Tarmac drives, resurfacing, and council-spec road surfaces.
- [Patios](https://www.jgslimited.co.uk/patios/): Porcelain, sandstone, and natural stone patios.
- [Drop Kerbs](https://www.jgslimited.co.uk/drop-kerbs/): Council-approved drop kerb installations.
- [Fencing & Landscaping](https://www.jgslimited.co.uk/fencing-landscapes/): Fencing, decking, and full garden makeovers.
- [Drainage Work](https://www.jgslimited.co.uk/drainage-work/): Soakaways, channel drains, SuDS-compliant drainage.

## Service Areas

Derbyshire — Derby, Belper, Ripley, Heanor, Alfreton, Matlock, Chesterfield, Long Eaton, Ilkeston, Codnor, Kilburn, Heage, Duffield, Breadsall, Ashbourne.
